description: A Claude Code session transcript captured by the Stop hook.
A durable topic note written by the user or by mneme_write.
An external reference document (URL, paper, snippet) stored in the vault.
A reusable action-pattern record written by the patterns subsystem (PATTERN_TYPE constant).
A per-session trajectory transcript written by the trajectory subsystem (TRAJECTORY_TYPE constant).

A captured Python failure (parsed traceback) recorded by mneme-code.
